info.description:
# Description

This is the beta version of the v12 api. **For more information see the [suomi.fi service developer's documentation](https://kehittajille.suomi.fi/palvelut/palvelutietovaranto/rajapinta-ja-arkkitehtuuriuudistus)**

## Authentication

API key is required to use the API. On how to create and API key see the [API key user guide](https://kehittajille.suomi.fi/palvelut/palvelutietovaranto/rajapinta-ja-arkkitehtuuriuudistus/api-avaimen-kayttoohje-ptv-rajapintaversio-12)

## Code Generation

When generating code from the api specification make sure the code generator supports [OpenAPI Specification v3.1.1](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html). Some code generators only support older versions which typically means they do not know how to process `ref`, `anyOf` or `oneOf` correctly causing code generation to generate same type/class multiple times.

The [OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech/) ([GitHub](https://github.com/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator)) has beta support for OAS v3.1.

tags.name: Service channel
tags.description:
A service channel is a channel through which a customer can use a [service](#tag/service).

A service channel is associated to a service via a [connection](#tag/connection).

There are five different service channel types, each with tailored set of attributes for describing the typical use case.

- EService for online customer service
- TelephoneService for service via phone
- PrintableForm for printable documents
- ServiceLocation for physical locations
- WebPage for information on a website

tags.name: Connection
tags.description:
Connection joins [service](#tag/service) and [service channel](#tag/service-channel) together with many to many relationship.

This means that same service can be accessed via multiple channels and
same channel can be used for accessing multiple services.

The channels that have `allowedConnectionType` set to `AllOrganizations` can be connected to any organizations' services.

tags.name: General description
tags.description:
A general description is a ready-made template intended as the basis for describing a [service](#tag/service).
Using a general description reduces the amount of work needed to describe and update a service.

tags.name: Organization
tags.description:
An organisation is used as background information explaining which
organisation is responsible for a service or a service channel or
for providing a service. Each [service](#tag/service) and
[service channel](#tag/service-channel) belongs to an organization.

tags.name: Service
tags.description:
The service is the central concept of PTV.

The data of a service describes what kind of service the customer receives,
for whom the service is intended and how the user can obtain the service.

Services are connected to service channels via [connections](#tag/connection).

tags.name: Service collection
tags.description:
Service collections are used to group [services](#tag/service) and [service channels](#tag/service-channel) together
to create thematic groups.
